# Spiking_Sequence_Generator

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A neuromorphic circuit that generates precise spatiotemporal spike sequences to encode polar coordinate trajectories for robotic or sensory processing. Enables efficient, event-driven encoding of spatial trajectories directly in spiking hardware, bridging neuromorphic sensing and motor control.
